AMENDMENT NO. 2 dated as of February 2, 2026 to the Credit Agreement dated as of January 20, 2025 (as amended by Amendment No. 1 dated as of August 15, 2025), among Westmark Logistics Holdings LLC, as Borrower, the Lenders party hereto and Pinnacle Commercial Bank, as Administrative Agent.

SECTION 1. Amendments . Section 7.01(e) of the Credit Agreement is hereby deleted in its entirety and replaced with the words "[Reserved]".

SECTION 2. Effectiveness . This Amendment shall become effective on February 2, 2026.
